posts.text:
CREATE YOUR OWN REALITY. FEED YOUR MIND GOOD STUFF. DO WHAT EXCITES YOU.

Your head, your rules.

Tag a human who lives this.

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #Motivation
posts.alt: Quote card: Create your own reality. Feed your mind good stuff. Do what excites you.

posts.text:
LAUGH FIRST. FIGURE IT OUT SECOND.

Works on almost every problem humans have.

Somebody you know needs this one today.

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #FunnyQuotes
posts.alt: Quote card: Laugh first. Figure it out second.

posts.text:
BROKEN ISN'T DONE. IT'S A STARTING POINT.

Ask anyone who fixes things for a living.

Who needed this one today?

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #ItsOnlyMetal
posts.alt: Quote card: Broken isn't done. It's a starting point.

posts.text:
PATIENCE. PRACTICE. TIME. CHANGE SHOWS UP.

Slow doesn't mean never.

Send this to your favorite human.

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #KeepGoing
posts.alt: Quote card: Patience. Practice. Time. Change shows up.

posts.text:
CAN'T CONTROL EVENTS. YOU CONTROL THE RESPONSE.

That's where all your power is hiding.

Save this one for the hard days.

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #LifeAdvice
posts.alt: Quote card: Can't control events. You control the response.

posts.text:
BRAVEST THING YOU CAN BE? YOURSELF.

No costume. No permission slip needed.

Tag a human who lives this.

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #BeHuman
posts.alt: Quote card: Bravest thing you can be? Yourself.

posts.text:
SMALL EFFORTS. EVERY SINGLE DAY.

That's the whole secret. It was never a secret.

Somebody you know needs this one today.

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #Motivation
posts.alt: Quote card: Small efforts. Every single day.

posts.text:
YOU NEVER FALL UNTIL YOU STOP TRYING.

Down is a place. Staying is a choice.

Who needed this one today?

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #KeepGoing
posts.alt: Quote card: You never fall until you stop trying.
